column2:
To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

You have served [Root.Society.GetName] well, and those above you have taken note. I grant you leave to rise to the next rank among us. Do not make me regret it.

[From.GetTitledFirstName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],\n\n[Root.Society.GetName] has no master to speak for it, so its eldest members have weighed your request among themselves. They find you worthy. Rise to the next rank, and serve as well above as you did below.
It is my privilege.

They are all staring at me, whispering behind my back! When I turn my head they look away, but I am sure of it. They know. Perhaps not everything, but enough. The cook, the guards, my own steward. Any one of them could be counting the nights I slip away, and any one of them could sell me to the witch hunters.

Some days I think I am going mad. It is probably all in my head, but I keep catching people looking at me. When my courtiers whisper I cannot help wondering if they speak of me, and every knock at the door at night makes my heart stop. A secret like mine weighs more each year.
How long before I crack under the strain?

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

The Order does not keep blades that will not cut. You no longer meet what we ask of those who serve us, and so your name is struck from our rolls. Remember what you swore. Speak of what you have seen among us, and you will not hear the one we send for you.

[From.GetTitledFirstName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

The god has turned his gaze from you, and so do we. You are no longer one of us. Know that we have long memories and many friends in dark places. If a word of our rites ever reaches a witch hunter, we will know whose tongue it came from, and we will have it.

[From.GetTitledFirstName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

It has come to our attention that you no longer keep the faith our order serves. We pray you will see your error and return to the true path, but until then you have no place among us. The doors of our houses are closed to you.

[From.GetTitledFirstName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

It has come to our attention that you no longer live up to the standards we expect of our members. We hold no grudge, and we hope you will find your way back to the pursuit of learning, but for now we must part ways.

[From.GetTitledFirstName]

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

It has come to our attention that you no longer meet what [Root.Society.GetName] asks of its members. We wish you no ill, but we can no longer count you among us.

[From.GetTitledFirstName]
It seems I made some enemies today.
I had a feeling it would come to this.
I no longer meet what [From.GetName] asks of those who would join it.

The work of [Root.Society.GetName] has brought me together with [From.GetTitledFirstName] far more often than I would like. Every meeting ends in sneers and barbed words, and I am certain [From.GetSheHe] speaks against me whenever I am not in the room.
I will show the world what a snake [From.GetFirstName] is!
Patience. It will pay off in the end.

Again and again the work of [Root.Society.GetName] has brought me together with [From.GetTitledFirstName], and every meeting has been a pleasure. We think alike in so many things, and I find myself looking forward to the next.
I think this is friendship!
Or perhaps it is something more...
You realize you have been taken with §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! all along, and confess it.
I am reading too much into this.
I may be leaning on the powers of [Root.Society.GetName] too freely. People have begun to whisper about me.
Let them whisper.
The whispers have turned to open talk. Servants fall silent when I walk in, and my own vassals watch me with narrowed eyes. If I am not careful, someone will soon put a name to what I do.
I must be more careful.
I have kept my dealings with [Root.Society.GetName] quiet for some time, and the worst of the talk has died down. Some still watch me, but fewer than before.
I have kept my dealings with [Root.Society.GetName] quiet for so long that people have forgotten to whisper about me.
I have grown careless. The truth about my dealings with [Root.Society.GetName] is out, and everyone from the lowest stable boy to the highest priest knows what I am.
My mission [Root.GetQuestName] involving [From.GetTitledFirstName] can no longer be carried out.
[From.GetName] has fallen on hard times and has no members left. Its halls stand empty, but its name still carries weight. I could take up its banner and lead it myself.
It will rise again under me!
No, this is not what I had in mind.
So be it.
A wasted effort.

Greetings, [Root.GetTitledFirstName]!
We are delighted to hear that you have taken your first step towards wisdom. Verena gave mankind the written word, and the Order of Mysteries goes after what was written and lost, in musty libraries, distant ruins and haunted tombs. There is a place for you among us.

Go with the Owl, for She will show you the way to knowledge.
Signed, [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName]

Greetings, [Root.GetTitledFirstName]!
We are delighted to hear that you take an interest in the unknown corners of the world. New discoveries and new adventures await you, and the League asks only an entrance fee of 100 gold to keep its maps, ships and guides.

We look forward to your discoveries and your tales from across the world.
Signed, [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName]

Greetings, [Root.GetTitledFirstName].\nWe are delighted to hear that you take an interest in the unknown corners of the world. Alas, the League cannot waive its entrance fee of 100 gold, not even for a [Root.GetTitle]. Write to us again when your coffers allow it.\nSigned, [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName]
It is about time I set out on the seas to make a proper name for myself. A ship, a crew of cutthroats and the whole coast to plunder: what more could a pirate want?
It is about time I set out on the seas to make a proper name for myself as a corsair. The fat merchantmen of Tilea and the Empire sail past our coast, and every one of them is a gift from the gods.
Itz time ta deal wiv dese squealin' panzee sea gitz an' show 'em 'ow a proppa boss getz da best lootz.
It is about time I took a black ark of my own to sea. The coasts of the lesser races are rich with slaves and plunder, and the Corsairs of Naggaroth take what they want.
This is what I wanted to hear!
I shall gladly pay the fee.
To sea!
On second thought, I would rather not.

Many years of my life have been given to [Root.Society.GetName], to its missions, its secrets and its quarrels. Today all of it has been rewarded: I am the new [Root.GetSocietyRank]. My brothers and sisters now look to me for leadership and guidance.
And leadership and guidance I shall give.
You cannot spare 100 gold.
